props.text: 45,000 particles in the *double gyre*, a standard model of mixing in ocean flows: two eddies side by side, whose shared boundary wobbles back and forth. Each particle is colored by where it started, sky blue at the left wall to violet at the right; the wobble folds the two eddies into each other. **Shift-drag** a box to drop dye: every particle that passes through it turns gold and carries the dye downstream, stretched into thin filaments. Set the wobble to 0 and the eddies never mix. Escape or a click outside the box clears it.
